summary: Phases 1-9 of Route P landed and committed, each individually build/lint/lean_verify-clean. Phases 1-8: see prior handoffs (ordered stepper, termination measure, S4LoopInv preservation with keysDistinct machine-checked unweakened, ordered driver + entry point, empirical gate confirming the ordered driver does not close cex while the shipped driver does, with zero verdict-change deltas on the size<=6 sweep). Phase 9 (Propagation-Adequacy Invariant) is now COMPLETE: landed a single additive ~282-line section in Cslib/Logics/Modal/Tableau/FrameSoundness.lean (immediately after the existing S4 4-rule soundness lemmas, before '## B (Symmetric Frame)'), containing branchPropAdequateIn (the weakened S4 invariant: same branch-formula conjunct as branchSatisfiableIn, but the edge conjunct is replaced by a branch-content-driven one that a redirect edge -- not a genuine m.r edge -- can satisfy), branchSatisfiableIn_imp_branchPropAdequateIn (mint edges get the weaker invariant for free), the adequacy analogues of the two 4-rule trans_mem lemmas and their rule-level wrappers (modalFourBoxProp_sound_adequate/modalFourDiaNegProp_sound_adequate), the K box-positive rule's adequacy analogue (the third consumer named by the research, using s4FC's reflexive half directly), and modalClosed_unsat_propAdequateIn (direct transcription of modalClosed_unsat, which only ever consumes the branch-formula conjunct). All six declarations are sorry-free and axiom-clean (lean_verify: only propext/Quot.sound). git diff on FrameSoundness.lean is purely additive (282 insertions, 0 deletions); every pre-existing declaration is byte-for-byte unchanged. KEY MATHEMATICAL DISCOVERY (see phase-10 handoff for the full writeup): the two 4-rule adequacy analogues and the K-rule analogue each needed an explicit 'hready' hypothesis added beyond the plan's literal wording -- unlike branchSatisfiableIn's edge conjunct (branch-independent), branchPropAdequateIn's edge conjunct is branch-content-driven, so adding a new box/diamond-shaped formula at a target world w' reopens the conjunct's obligation at every edge already recorded out of w'; the bare, hypothesis-free analogue is false for an unconstrained acc. hready states exactly the mint-readiness guarantee (Phase 4) that Phase 10's own goal ('Redirect-Inertness', blockedRedirect_boxctx_mem) is designed to discharge for the redirect-edge case -- this is not new scope, it is the natural signature the plan's own wording implies once actually derived in Lean, and it directly foreshadows/motivates Phase 10's stated obligation. Full CI green: lake build (3257 jobs, whole project), checkInitImports, lint-style, lake lint (same one pre-existing out-of-scope error in Temporal/Tableau/Saturation.lean, zero new issues), lake shake (zero import changes suggested for FrameSoundness.lean), mk_all (no update necessary for this phase; a concurrent session's Nested/Rules.lean addition left a pending Cslib.lean diff that this dispatch deliberately did not touch/stage/commit), lake test (exit 0). Repo-wide axiom count unchanged at 26.
decisions_made: Phase 4 deviation: modalStepBranchS4KeyedOrdered's shared per-formula body is factored into a new NAMED definition (modalStepBranchS4KeyedBody) rather than duplicated inline as the phase-4 handoff had sketched. modalStepBranchS4Keyed's own source is byte-for-byte unchanged; the bridge modalStepBranchS4Keyed_eq_findSome_body (rfl) relates the two. This made the three required structural lemmas provable against a named term instead of restating a six-way match inline in every statement.

Phase 4 deviation: modalStepBranchS4KeyedOrdered_mintReady's hypothesis is phrased as '∀ sf, body sf = tuple → mintShape sf = true' (universally quantified over every formula that could have produced the exact output tuple) rather than a single externally-supplied selected formula, since no cheap uniqueness argument establishes that only one formula in b can produce a given output tuple. This is the airtight, general form; verified sound via the shared _cases case split.

Phase 5 discovery (see phase-6 handoff for full writeup): a `let (a,b):=f x; body` pattern-match compiles to direct `.1`/`.2` PROJECTIONS when `f` is an ABSTRACT parameter (as modalStepBranchGen's `apply` is) but to a full `match` when `f` is a CONCRETE, already-known function (as in modalStepBranchS4KeyedBody). This determines which of two rewriting idioms (`.1`-based rcases+rw, vs. rcases-pair+rw-at-hypothesis+re-derive-`.1`-facts-via-`have`) applies to a given hypothesis, and caused two rounds of build-error debugging before the correct idiom was identified. This WILL recur in every one of Phase 6's ten sub-lemmas.

Phase 5 discovery: `Option.some.inj h` (raw term) + a bare-name `obtain ⟨rfl, name, -⟩` pattern lets rcases's internal substitution unify a free `newExp`-shaped variable with a branch-specific value (e++[sf] for linear/branching, e itself for persistent) the rest of a measure/invariant proof needs; pre-simplifying via `simp only [Option.some.injEq, Prod.mk.injEq] at h` first BLOCKS this unification and leaves the goal unsolvable. Matches the exact idiom the pre-existing (untouched) modalExpMeasure_step_lt_S4Keyed proof already relies on.

Phase 5's projection bridge (modalStepBranchS4KeyedOrdered_proj) intentionally does NOT assert the ordered stepper's result equals modalStepBranchGen's own whole-branch findSome? traversal at modalApplyOneS4Keyed φ₀ keys (that would be FALSE in general -- a different formula may genuinely be selected first, the entire point of reordering). It instead extracts the weaker existential fact the measure proof actually consumes: some sf ∈ b, sf ∉ e, whose rule application produces exactly the given result.

Phase 9 addition beyond the plan's literal task-list wording: `branchPropAdequateIn_s4FC_boxPos_trans_mem`/`_diaNeg_trans_mem` and `branchPropAdequateIn_boxPos_mem` each carry an explicit `hready` hypothesis (for every edge already recorded out of the target world w', the corresponding box/diamond content is already on the branch there). Justification: branchPropAdequateIn's edge conjunct is branch-content-driven (unlike branchSatisfiableIn's), so adding a new box/diamond-shaped formula reopens the conjunct's obligation at w''s existing outgoing edges; the hypothesis-free analogue is false for an unconstrained acc. hready is exactly what Phase 4's mint-readiness discipline guarantees at real call sites, and its redirect-edge discharge is precisely Phase 10's stated goal (blockedRedirect_boxctx_mem). Not a weakening of any existing theorem (these are brand-new Phase 9 lemmas); documented in the phase-10 handoff for the next dispatch.

Phase 9's modalClosed_unsat_propAdequateIn cannot delegate to the existing modalClosed_unsat (its edges argument, while unused in the proof body, is still a genuine Prop that would need a real -- not fabricated -- proof term, which branchPropAdequateIn's weaker hypotheses do not supply in general). Resolved via direct transcription of modalClosed_unsat's tactic script against branchPropAdequateIn's own (identically-shaped) branch-formula conjunct, per the plan's own phrasing ('this should be a direct transcription'). Also required inlining `Proposition.beqToEq` as `LawfulBEq.eq_of_beq` since the original helper is `private` to SoundnessStep.lean.
flagged_theorem_changes: Phase 14 ADDS modalTableauS4KeyedOrdered_complete beside the landed modalTableauS4Keyed_complete (FrameCompleteness.lean); the landed theorem is not weakened. Not yet reached.

Phase 15 is the only destructive phase: it deletes modalStepBranchS4Keyed, modalExpandBranchesS4Keyed, modalTableauS4Keyed, modalTableauS4Keyed_complete and their stepper-specific support lemmas -- each with a proved ordered replacement. Removal-with-replacement, never weakening. Not yet reached.

Phase 6's escalation trigger (modalStepBranchS4KeyedOrdered_preserves_keysDistinct, attempted first per the handoff's recommendation) PASSED: keysUpdate_preserves_keysDistinct and blockingWorldS4Keyed_none_fresh are both consumed with their EXACT original signatures, no weakening. The plan's central claim -- reordering only changes timing, never producing a duplicate key -- is now machine-checked rather than assumed. No contradiction surfaced.

Phase 6 required TWO additional ordered-form auxiliaries not named in the plan text: modalStepBranchS4KeyedOrdered_branch_superset (prerequisite for keyLowerBd/keysWorldsKnown/worldsContiguousS4) and modalStepBranchS4KeyedOrdered_keys_subset (prerequisite for keysTotal). Both are verbatim transcriptions of their unordered counterparts via modalStepBranchS4KeyedOrdered_selected_mem, following the same case-split shape.

modalKnownWorlds_length_le_worldBoundS4/modalStepBranchS4_worldBound/modalExpMeasure_entry_le_fuelS4 all apply VERBATIM to the ordered driver with no ordered analogue needed: all three are stated purely over the pre-step b/keys or the entry-point modalUniverseS4 φ₀/modalFuelS4 φ₀, with no reference to which stepper (modalStepBranchS4Keyed vs. modalStepBranchS4KeyedOrdered) produced a given step. Confirmed, not assumed, per the plan's own instruction to prefer reuse and only re-derive if verbatim application genuinely fails.

No phase may discharge an obligation with sorry, an axiom, or a vacuous statement. Verified true of Phases 1-9: lean_verify on all new lemmas/defs reports only propext/Classical.choice/Quot.sound, and the repo-wide axiom count is unchanged at 26 throughout.

Phase 7 confirmed (not merely assumed) that the copied processNext fuel' recursion type-checks under Lean's own termination checker with zero changes to the recursion shape -- this is evidence against (not proof against) a termination gap at the driver-wiring level; the escalation concern remains formally live until Phases 9-14's soundness/completeness re-derivation is complete.

Phase 8 confirmed (machine-checked, not assumed) that modalExpandBranchesS4KeyedOrdered does not close cex while modalExpandBranchesS4Keyed does, on both the #guard_msgs test row and an independent lake env lean run. The exhaustive size<=6 sweep found zero verdict changes of either direction between the two drivers -- an honest negative result at that scope (cex itself is larger than size 6), not further confirmation of the fix. The termination-regression prediction is not corroborated by this phase (fuel-exhausted stayed at 0 for both drivers across the full sweep) but remains formally open pending Phases 9-14's proof-level work.

Phase 9 confirmed the propagation-adequacy invariant is definable and its three named consumer lemmas are provable, but only with the hready side condition documented above -- this refines (does not retire) the standing termination/completeness prediction: the redirect-edge case's actual soundness now hinges on Phase 10 proving hready is genuinely discharged by mint-readiness, not merely assumed.
dead_ends: Route Q (split accessibility record) is not planned: the research rejects it as strictly worse, reducing to Route P's step-2 obligation with extra bookkeeping.
No phase edits blockingWorldS4Keyed's comparison predicate; every local guard edit was refuted in research. Confirmed Phases 1-5 made zero edits to it beyond its Phase 2 docstring.

Phase 5's first attempt at modalStepBranchS4KeyedOrdered_proj hand-typed a fresh let/match expression restating modalApplyOneS4Keyed's dispatch directly in the lemma's conclusion (mirroring modalStepBranchGen's shape textually). Abandoned: this elaborates via a full `match` (not projections, since the function is concrete at that elaboration site), breaking every subsequent `.1`-based rewrite the surrounding measure proof needed. Reusing the already-elaborated modalStepBranchS4KeyedBody (via Option.map to drop the keys' component) sidesteps the issue entirely -- this is now the established pattern for all future selection-agnostic bridge lemmas.

Phase 9's first considered approach for the two 4-rule adequacy analogues was a fully unconditional restatement (no extra hypothesis), mirroring the plan's literal wording. Abandoned once the branch-membership-driven edge conjunct's re-opened Case-B obligation (see phase-10 handoff) was identified as unprovable in general for an unconstrained acc; replaced by the hready-qualified versions instead of silently weakening the conclusion or introducing a sorry.
